content: vue3-apexcharts 1.11.1 (published 2026-03-03, npm registry). Thin Vue 3 wrapper around apexcharts 5.x. Provides <apexchart> component with type/series/options props. Maintained but not ApexCharts-official (official only ships vanilla JS). For PrimeVue+Tailwind codebase it duplicates charting surface already present via PrimeVue Chart (Chart.js wrapper) and adds a second rendering lib.
